stages.task: You are a gray now. Walk in like you own the place.

objectives.label: The front door
objectives.text: Up the stairs and through the front door. Walk, don't run: grays don't run.

stages.name: Arrival

stages.task: Get past the family. Everybody is looking at you.

objectives.label: Vestibule
objectives.text: Through the vestibule. (The coat check wants a word: X.)

objectives.label: Take a canapé
objectives.text: Blend in: take a canapé from the butler.

stages.name: The Receiving Line

stages.task: The cake is in the middle of the hall. Your gear is inside it.

objectives.label: The reception
objectives.text: Into the reception. Don't stare at the cake.

objectives.label: The toast
objectives.text: The MC is calling for a toast... from YOU. Go to the microphone and talk (X).

stages.name: The Reception

stages.task: Your cover is blown. The family wants you dead.

objectives.label: The guests
objectives.text: Fight! The tables are cover (some of them won't hold your weight).

objectives.label: The tommy gun
objectives.text: The tommy-gun gray is on the dais, behind the head table. He PAINTS his sweep with a red laser first. Get behind cover or jump the line.

objectives.label: Service door
objectives.text: The service door is open. Through the kitchens -- the Godmother is upstairs.

stages.name: The Wedding Brawl

objectives.label: Corridor
objectives.text: Down the service corridor.

objectives.label: The Muscle
objectives.text: THE MUSCLE. His chest plate blocks bullets: blast it open with the BELLOWS (or a hammer fist), then shoot the glow.

objectives.label: Laundry landing
objectives.text: Through to the laundry.

stages.task: The house runs on tractor beams. So do you.

objectives.label: Lift beam
objectives.text: See the basket riding the blue beam? Down the stairs and step into the LIFT BEAM.

objectives.label: Catwalk
objectives.text: Ride it up, then steer out onto the catwalk.

objectives.label: Over the vents
objectives.text: Hop into the next beam. Don't fall: the steam vents below are scalding.

objectives.label: The timed beam
objectives.text: This beam runs on the wash cycle: it FLICKERS before it cuts out. Wait for it to come back, then ride it up.

stages.name: The Laundry

stages.task: The kitchen ceiling is all rails.

objectives.label: Kitchen balcony
objectives.text: Into the kitchen.

objectives.label: Rail beam
objectives.text: Step under the RAIL BEAM (cyan) when it comes back. It carries you. Jump to let go.

objectives.label: Over the vats
objectives.text: Ride the next rail over the sauce vats. The cooks will shoot -- shoot back.

objectives.label: To the casino
objectives.text: Through the door: CASINO LA LUNA.

stages.name: The Kitchen

stages.task: The house always wins. Tonight, the house is you.

objectives.label: La Luna
objectives.text: Casino La Luna. (A green janitor is mopping the balcony: X to talk.)

objectives.label: The crossing
objectives.text: Ride the rail beam WEST. Where it crosses the other rail it stops: JUMP across onto the blue one and ride it NORTH to the VIP box.

objectives.label: The roulette floor
objectives.text: Down to the ROULETTE FLOOR. The Consigliere SHIELDS his family (the purple bubbles): pop the brain jar first. Mind the ball.

objectives.label: House rules
objectives.text: They're not done. Tommy-guns on the balconies!

objectives.label: West door
objectives.text: The west gate's open: on to the conservatory.

stages.name: Casino La Luna

stages.task: The family grows its own. Under a fake moon.

objectives.label: The grow-house
objectives.text: See the cow? Those red beams ABDUCT. Caught in one, JUMP three times to struggle free -- or get probed.

objectives.label: Through the rows
objectives.text: Cross the crop rows to the south door. Time the beams. (A lift beam in the far corner goes up through the roof...)

stages.name: The Conservatory

stages.task: Four hundred years of grays, all looking at you.

objectives.label: The family portraits
objectives.text: The family portraits. Somebody's up on the mezzanine...

objectives.label: The Button Man
objectives.text: THE BUTTON MAN. Watch for his red laser: it LOCKS just before he fires -- step aside. Hit him while he aims and the shot's spoiled.

objectives.label: To the chapel
objectives.text: South, to the family chapel. (The west door is the Don's study...)

stages.name: The Portrait Gallery

objectives.label: The chapel
objectives.text: The family chapel. The Godmother, as a saint. Of course.

objectives.label: Mass
objectives.text: Three Consiglieri, passing their shields round the pews. Pop the jars, then the family.

objectives.label: Back to the reception
objectives.text: The way up is the reception's dome. Down the corridor and back into the hall.

stages.task: All the way up. She's at the top.

objectives.label: The north gallery
objectives.text: Up the stairs to the north gallery.

objectives.label: The ring rail
objectives.text: Into the lift beam, up to the RING RAIL round the dome. Ride it to the south and jump off onto the ledge.

objectives.label: The carry beam
objectives.text: That ORANGE beam is a carry beam: step in and let it take you up to the high ring.

objectives.label: The oculus
objectives.text: Round the high ring to the north (red beams patrol it), then walk out onto the landing pad: its lift takes you up to the oculus.

objectives.label: The Spine Beam
objectives.text: Quiet up here. ...The Spine Beam goes straight to her. Step in.

stages.name: The Climb

stages.task: You can't beat her. Make her RESPECT you.

objectives.label: The truce
objectives.text: She raised her hand. "Enough."

stages.name: The Godmother
